dimControl: Tools for Geometric Processing and Dimensional Analysis

Source: R/dimControl-package.R
dimControl-package.Rd

A collection of tools for geometric processing, reconstruction, and dimensional analysis of three-dimensional data.

Main functionality

dimControl provides functionality for point cloud and mesh processing, boundary extraction, angle estimation, component detection, surface reconstruction, and geometric analysis.
